They found that playing patients' favorite music worked best.

titulo: Natural compound shows promise against C. difficile while largely sparing healthy gut bacteria
resumo: The pathogen Clostridioides difficile (C. difficile) is naturally present in the intestines of many people. When present in small numbers, it usually causes no symptoms. Treatment with broad-spectrum antibiotics can severely disrupt the balance of the healthy gut microbiome, allowing the bacterium to multiply unchecked. The result is acute intestinal inflammation, which can also become chronic. Such infections with C. difficile (CDI) are among the leading causes of antibiotic-associated diarrhea. Since the bacteria release toxins that can lead to dangerous, sometimes life-threatening intestinal inflammation with high relapse rates, new therapeutic approaches are urgently needed.

titulo: New Outlook stores your settings in a hidden file. You should back it up
resumo: For the past couple of years, Microsoft has made a concerted effort to move users from the classic Outlook app for Windows 11 to “new” Outlook, a web-based app. If you’re using new Outlook, you should take advantage of the ability to back up your account settings. These settings are stored in the ‘UserSettings.json’ file, which you can find in the ‘C:\Users\[username]\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Olk’ folder. If you have set up multiple accounts in Outlook, you will find separate configuration files in each of the individual user folders. To create a backup, copy this file or these files to another secure location, or include them in the backups created by your backup software. To restore the configuration, simply copy the JSON file back to its original location. If the Olk folder is missing — for example, after reinstalling Outlook — create it manually. The configuration will be applied automatically when you start Outlook. resumo: An undergraduate astrophysics student at UC Berkeley has found three unusual galaxies—cataloged as Shapiro Dwarf Galaxies I, II and III. The discovery, published in The Astrophysical Journal, provides compelling observational evidence of a long-held astronomical theory.

titulo: Platinum in fuel cells lasts longer with nitrogen-enhanced graphene wrapper

titulo: Scientists warn a popular vitamin D supplement may have a hidden downside

Previous studies also suggest that vitamin D3 may provide stronger immune protection against viruses and bacteria.

Nos Estados Unidos , o número ultrapassava 4,8 mil registros , enquanto na Espanha havia mais de 500 notificações. Os números do Downdetector representam notificações enviadas à plataforma, e não a quantidade total de pessoas afetadas pela falha. titulo: The U.S. Nuclear Plant Fleet Is Leaning Into AI

Even well-trained managers struggle with the operational complexity of a nuclear reactor. It’s not the kind of setting that seems well suited to a powerful but error-prone new technology. Reality tells a startlingly different story. A variety of companies have begun to offer AI solutions for nuclear power.
